# true-code

> Open-source agentic coding harness in Rust (MIT). Shows what the agent did and what it cost: live cost per turn, budget caps, diff preview before every write, evidence blocks instead of self-reported success. Providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter - keys in the OS keyring.

- Repository: https://github.com/philppplik/true-code
- Install guide: https://github.com/philppplik/true-code/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
- Developer: https://trc.philipp-paulik.de/entwickler/philipp-paulik/
